newsitem.title: CHINA: Quake rocks China region, no casualties reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake rocks China region, no casualties reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.1 on the Richter scale rocked a county in China's northwestern region of Xinjiang on Tuesday, the Xinhua news agency reported.
There were no reports of any damage or casualties from the tremor, which hit Xinjiang's Jiashi county, the agency said.
The earthquake struck at 5.24 p.m. (0924 GMT) with its epicentre at 39.5 degrees north and 77.0 degrees east, Xinhua quoted the State Seismological Bureau as saying.
"The quake was strongly felt in the county seat, but no casualties or damages have been reported yet," it said.
The tremor was one of a series of aftershocks that have shaken Jiashi county in western Xinjiang since January, it said but gave no details.
Local seismological departments were keeping a close watch on the quake-hit area.
